## 4

```{r}
sum_n <- function(n) {
  sum(1:n)
}
```

```{r}
sum_n(5000)
```

## 5

```{r}
altman_plot <- function(x, y) {
  sum_x_y <- sum(x, y)
  difference_x_y <- x - y
  plot(sum_x_y, difference_x_y)
}
```

## 6

```{r}
x <- 3
my_func <- function(y) {
  x <- 5
  y+5
}
```

```{r}
x
```

## 7

```{r}
compute_s_n <- function(n) {
  sum((1:n)^2)
}
```

```{r}
compute_s_n(10)
```

## 8

```{r}
m <- 25
s_n <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = m)

for (n in 1:m) {
  s_n[n] <- compute_s_n(n)
}
```

```{r}
s_n
```

## 9

```{r}
n <- 1:m
s_n <- sapply(n, compute_s_n)
s_n 
```

## 10

```{r}
plot(n, s_n)
```

## 11

```{r}
# Generate the formula results for n = 1 to 25
n_values <- 1:m
formula_results <- n_values * (n_values + 1) * (2 * n_values + 1) / 6
```

```{r}
# Check if every single entry in the loop matches the formula
identical(s_n, formula_results)
```
